kb-update (22:30Z cycle, degraded DD-scan-diff): new false alarm added to kb/false-alarms.json: fa-2026-11-22-crotega-azure-hosted-public-app-analytics-beacon-noise

Monitor 77419271 (XHR errors per account) triggered on crotega at 21:42:11Z and recovered at 21:48:11Z. I checked 100 method-ui XHR errors from 21:41-21:43Z. All were http.status_code 0 and all came from AS8075 Microsoft hosting (25 IPs, 34 anonymous sessions). 97 of the 100 were the aborted 'Runtime Button Clicked' analytics beacon on crotega's public app page. No server-side errors for crotega, and 0 ms-gateway-api errors in the window. I rejected the gateway-timeout KI match.

Scoped to 'for account: crotega'. This is the 3rd account with this automated-client public-app shape (tcg3, sommselection). Worth having 77419271 exclude status_code:0 beacons or hosting ASNs.
